messages:
Lina R.: opened a small PR to clean up the Console observability guides: fixes for dashboard filters, one-line cost note, and a couple of snippet corrections. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5055 :wave:
Marco D.: quick skim : the Node dashboard example uses `traceId` in one filter and `trace_id` elsewhere, can we standardize to snake_case (`trace_id`)? small find but confuses readers.
Teja S.: I'll patch that. also spotted a missing `await` in the Node trace fetch snippet that makes the example render empty traces in the demo app.
Lina R.: thanks. can we also swap the kv-cache sample away from manual prefixing to the helper API? customers shouldn't copy internal key formats.
Teja S.: yep, will change:
```js
// before
await kv.set(`sess:${sid}:kv`, value)
// after
await kv.setForSession(sid, value)
```
Marco D.: tiny UX ask: add an anchor next to the cost table labeled "trace attribution" so PMs can link directly. an HTML anchor with id `trace-attribution` is fine.
Lina R.: good idea. can someone add a 1-line non-tech note under the cost matrix about sequence length: "Shorter average sequences tend to improve batching and reduce per-token costs."
Marco D.: added that sentence in my patch. also replaced two links pointing at `/sdk/node/legacy` to `/sdk/node/current`.
docs-bot: docs CI passed for PR #5055 (build 4870) :white_check_mark:
Teja S.: pushed await + kv helper + snake_case fixes. adjusted code fence language to `javascript` for proper highlighting.
Lina R.: final checklist: 1) squash lint bot commit 2) Marco verify wording 3) merge after approvals. anyone object to me merging this afternoon?
Marco D.: no objections, will re-approve after squash.
Teja S.: none.
Lina R.: thanks all :tada: tagging #product-docs for visibility.
__notes: Short Slack thread coordinating docs PR edits: filter naming consistency, await fix, kv helper swap, link replacements, anchor addition, sequence-length cost note, CI pass.
